# Console commands run as the server console; `@bot` = player Bot (op, level 4), `@bot0` = player Bot0 (level 0).
# Time-dependent values are avoided (daytime/gametime advance on both servers at their own pace).
gamerule advance_time false
gamerule advance_weather false
